channel.title: d0rz asks
channel.description: Customer asks on d0rz — free-form requests for rides, delivery, errands, pet care, home help, and more.

item.title: Need a website usability tester for a local delivery app
item.description:
I am building a local delivery service and need someone in the Dallas-Fort Worth area to test the customer flow: browse services, place a mock order for grocery pickup, and report any confusing steps or bugs. Takes about 30 minutes via video call or in person. I will pay $15 for detailed feedback.
Budget: $15
City: Dallas, TX

item.title: Need someone to test d0rz and leave feedback on usability
item.description:
Looking for beta testers to try out d0rz.com (local rides, errands, delivery marketplace) and provide honest feedback on usability, UX, and any bugs found. Flexible schedule, remote work. Just sign up, browse around, and send your thoughts via chat. Takes ~15 minutes.
Budget: $15
City: San Francisco, CA

item.title: Need a local SF Bay Area runner to grab a package from my office and drop at UPS
item.description:
I have a small prepaid parcel (about 2 lbs) at my office in SoMa that needs to go to the UPS drop box on Mission St. Pick up any weekday after 5pm, drop same evening, send me the drop-off photo. Total effort under 30 minutes. Looking for a local provider to quote this.
Budget: $8
City: San Francisco, CA
